accepted_native_limits.recovery_semantics: The NPC's ScriptContext_SetupScript replaces the parked Rock script: WAITING1 -> RUNNING0 -> SHUTDOWN2. It does not resume EventScript_SmashRock's pending releaseall/end. This row's PASS depends on the verified NPC interaction; without it the retained901e888d A-only run timed out while WAITING persisted for over21500 observed frames.
